description: List the photos and videos on a Google Business Profile gallery (the media shown on Maps and Search) for one location/account or every accessible GBP location. This is separate from media attached to a post. Returns each item's resource name, category, format, image URL, and date. Pages the gallery already fetched from Google: limit defaults to 50 (max 200) and offset skips that many items.

account_id.description: Google Business account ID from list_accounts.

limit.description: Items per page. Default 50, max 200. This pages the gallery already fetched; it does not ask Google for a smaller page.

location_id.description: Google Business numeric location id (the location_id/platform_user_id from list_accounts, e.g. "197940849675145390"). NOT the ChIJ... Place ID from list_google_business_reviews view=review_link. Prefer account_id.

offset.description: Items to skip. Use the offset the previous page gives.

workspace_id.description: Filter to a workspace ID from whoami.

name: list_google_business_media
